info.name: List entry identifiers for a database

params.name: database
params.description: KEGG database name or organism code. Supported databases: pathway, brite, module, ko, genome, compound, glycan, reaction, rclass, enzyme, disease, drug, dgroup, network, variant, and organism codes.

items.docs: Obtain a list of entry identifiers and associated names for a KEGG database. Returns tab-delimited text.

info.name: List pathways for a specific organism

params.name: org
params.description: KEGG organism code (e.g., hsa, eco, mmu)

items.docs: Obtain a list of pathway entry identifiers and names for a specific organism identified by its KEGG organism code (e.g., hsa for human, eco for E. coli).
